Call an impure R function from compiled code

Source: R/callbacks.R
experimental_io_callback.Rd

Port of jax.experimental.io_callback. Like pure_callback(), but the callback is treated as having side effects: it is not removed when its results are unused, and it cannot be differentiated. Under vmap() it is called once per batch element (an ordered callback cannot be vmapped). ordered = TRUE orders the ordered callbacks of one compiled region with a token.

Usage

experimental_io_callback(
  callback,
  result_shape_dtypes,
  ...,
  sharding = NULL,
  ordered = FALSE
)

io_callback(
  callback,
  result_shape_dtypes,
  ...,
  sharding = NULL,
  ordered = FALSE
)

Arguments

callback

An R function.

result_shape_dtypes

A pytree of ShapeDtypeStruct() values (or arrays) describing the results.

...

Arguments (pytrees of arrays) passed to callback; named arguments are passed by name.

sharding

Ignored (single device).

ordered

Whether calls must keep their program order.

Value

A pytree of arrays with the structure of result_shape_dtypes.
